description: Source code for DSA ASN.1 encoding/decoding functions in OpenSSL's BoringSSL fork, including parsing, marshaling, and key validation.

methods.name: dsa_check_key

methods.name: DSA_SIG_marshal
methods.description: Serializes a DSA signature to ASN.1.

methods.name: DSA_parse_public_key
